name: io.github.horizonnowhere/ektro-mv
title: EKTRO-MV
description: Create delivery-ready music videos from one sentence or a reviewed creative brief.

environmentVariables.name: ARK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Volcengine Ark API key used by the default Seedance video provider.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key for prompt mode; not needed when supplying a reviewed brief.

environmentVariables.name: COMFYUI_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of a ComfyUI instance with ACE-Step installed.

environmentVariables.name: EKTRO_MV_OUTPUT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Root directory for isolated music-video run artifacts.
